name: Dice Rollers
source:
One table, a pack of dice, five participants: This story is about playing a tabletop RPG with swords and dragons while overcoming inner weaknesses.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483330/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一张桌子，一叠骰子，五个参与者：这个故事是关于玩剑与龙的桌面角色扮演游戏，同时克服内心的弱点。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483330/]Steam[/url]]
